scene: Rainy evening inside the parked red Subaru after the mountain trip. Two dogs on the back-seat bench inspect a black bear outside through the CLOSED side window. Neet stands stiffly on all four fine legs on the seat, nose near glass, barking with excessive official seriousness. Buddy sits slightly lower behind him, just his nose above seat/window edge, after three quick yaps, his body and haunch still visible below. A closed pizza box on the other portion of the seat is the apparent object they are guarding. Outside, the small distant black bear by a parking-lot trash can ignores them; credible window perspective, rain and night light. No humans visible, no windows open, no direct encounter, no dogs overlapping. The joke is confidence behind glass and concern for pizza. Preserve all legs/seat support, modest heads.
placement_after: Buddy, proud of his contribution, sat tall. “That’s right. We protected the pizza.”
alt_text: From behind the car window, Neet challenges an indifferent bear while Buddy guards the pizza.
